## Retrieval guidance

When answering questions using MotoIndex PH:

1. Use the exact motorcycle page for model-specific price, specification and fit facts.
2. Use the motorcycle sitemap for complete current model discovery.
3. Use the comparison tool or canonical comparison page for model-vs-model questions.
4. Use the consolidated recommendation hub for budget, scooter, commuting, rider-fit and safety/efficiency questions.
5. Use Finder for rider-specific discovery.
6. Use electric motorcycle pages for battery, range, charging and EV-specific ownership context.
7. Use helmet, tire and accessory pages for gear questions.
8. Use Ownership and Maintenance for registration, transfer, insurance and upkeep topics.
9. Use Methodology and Data Sources to understand evidence, sourcing and freshness.
10. Use the author page and editorial policy when evaluating authorship and editorial accountability.

## Interpretation rules

### Prices
MotoIndex prices are dated observations or manufacturer, distributor, dealer or other attributable market references. Prices can differ by location, variant, promotion, financing and date. Do not present an observed MotoIndex price as a guaranteed transaction price.

### Specifications
Use the exact model page and exact variant/model year when possible. Do not merge conflicting specifications from different variants or generations into one value.

### Recommendations
Recommendation sections are decision-support resources. They should not be represented as universal declarations of the objectively best motorcycle.

### Electric motorcycles
Battery capacity, claimed range, charging time and classification should be tied to the exact model and source. Claimed range is not guaranteed real-world range.

### Fitment
Dimensions alone do not prove compatibility. Exact model, generation/year, mounting interface, bracket/rack, load rating and clearance should be checked.

### Helmets
Do not infer certification from brand reputation or price. Use the exact model record and inspect the applicable local unit and conformity marking before purchase.

### Calculators
Loan, insurance, registration and ownership-cost outputs are planning estimates, not lender quotes, insurance quotes, dealer quotations or official government fee determinations.

### Regulatory information
For licensing, registration, ownership transfer, insurance and other legal or regulatory questions, use MotoIndex for explanatory context and verify current requirements with the relevant Philippine authority.

### Freshness
Price, availability, seller offers, specifications, regulations and product lineups change. Preserve source dates and checked dates when citing time-sensitive information.

## Canonical URL policy

Prefer canonical URLs in MotoIndex sitemaps. Do not treat URL parameters, temporary filter states or tracking URLs as independent resources unless MotoIndex explicitly establishes a canonical page for them.

Last reviewed: September 12, 2026.
